english.title: Vehicle fail to wait at a school crossing patrol - endorsable
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), and having been required to stop by a school crossing patrol, put the vehicle in motion again whilst required to remain stationary
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28(3) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedules 2 and 3 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
driver of a motor vehicle
on a road
required to stop at a school crossing patrol
put vehicle in motion again whilst required to remain stationary
whilst the school crossing sign was still exhibited

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Additional detail may be included in the Statement of Facts in relation to the number pedestrian(s) and the extent of any inconvenience or danger caused.
(ii) See also offence wording: H67 (fail to stop at school crossing - endorsable) and H102314 (fail to stop at school crossing - non-endorsable)
(iii) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty under Part 3 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 from the 24th February 2025 due to SI 2025/68.
(iv) This offence is endorsable. See H102315 for non-endorsable.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), and having been required to stop by a school crossing patrol, put the vehicle in motion again whilst required to remain stationary.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - £100 pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
